description: Curated destinations across India's heritage, spiritual, mountain, coastal, and wildlife experiences.

destinations.name: Mysore Palace (Amba Vilas)
destinations.summary: An magnificent Indo-Saracenic royal seat renowned for its grand arches, opulent interiors, and spectacular night illuminations.

details.history: Originally built of wood, the present palace was commissioned after a fire in 1897 and completed in 1912.
details.architecture: A blend of Hindu, Mughal, Rajput, and Gothic influences with ornate interiors, marble domes, and grand halls.
details.culturalSignificance: The official residence of the Wodeyar Maharajas and a major focal point of the annual Mysore Dasara celebrations.

travelTips.dressCode: Modest casual attire is recommended; footwear may need to be deposited in designated areas.
travelTips.entryFee: Entry fees vary for Indian and international visitors; check official sources before visiting.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography rules vary by section; photography may be restricted inside certain halls.

destinations.name: Amber Fort
destinations.summary: A magnificent hilltop fort known for grand courtyards, ornate palaces, mirror work, and panoramic views.

details.history: Construction began under Raja Man Singh I in the late 16th century and was expanded by successive Rajput rulers.
details.architecture: Rajput and Mughal architectural traditions are reflected in its gateways, courtyards, gardens, and decorative interiors.
details.culturalSignificance: Amber Fort represents the royal heritage of Jaipur and the Kachwaha Rajput dynasty.

travelTips.dressCode: Comfortable clothing and walking shoes are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Ticket prices vary; check official monument information before visiting.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally permitted, subject to restrictions in selected areas.

destinations.name: City Palace
destinations.summary: A spectacular lakeside palace complex combining Rajput grandeur, ornate balconies, courtyards, and museum collections.

details.history: The palace complex was developed over centuries by the Mewar rulers beginning in the 16th century.
details.architecture: Rajput architecture blends with Mughal influences, featuring towers, domes, courtyards, mirror work, and decorative mosaics.
details.culturalSignificance: It reflects the long royal history of Mewar and remains one of Udaipur's defining cultural landmarks.

travelTips.dressCode: Smart casual attire and comfortable footwear are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Entry fees vary by museum and visitor category.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed in designated areas, with restrictions in some museum sections.

destinations.name: Mehrangarh Fort
destinations.summary: An imposing hilltop fort overlooking the Blue City, celebrated for massive walls, royal galleries, and intricate stonework.

details.history: Founded by Rao Jodha in 1459, the fort was expanded by later rulers of Marwar.
details.architecture: The fortress combines imposing Rajput defensive architecture with richly decorated royal chambers.
details.culturalSignificance: Mehrangarh preserves the history, art, arms, and traditions of the Marwar royal family.

travelTips.dressCode: Comfortable clothes and sturdy walking shoes are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Admission varies by visitor category and selected experiences.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally permitted, subject to museum restrictions.

destinations.name: Taj Mahal
destinations.summary: An iconic white-marble mausoleum renowned worldwide for its symmetry, craftsmanship, and timeless beauty.

details.history: Commissioned by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal and completed in the 17th century.
details.architecture: An outstanding example of Mughal architecture with a symmetrical garden, marble dome, minarets, and intricate inlay work.
details.culturalSignificance: The monument is a symbol of Mughal-era art and one of India's most recognized cultural landmarks.

travelTips.dressCode: Modest comfortable clothing and comfortable walking shoes are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Ticket categories and prices vary; check official monument information.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is permitted in designated areas but restricted inside the mausoleum.

destinations.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
destinations.summary: One of India's most revered Shiva temples, located in the spiritual heart of Varanasi near the Ganges.

details.history: The temple has been rebuilt and restored multiple times over centuries and is associated with the ancient sacred traditions of Kashi.
details.architecture: The temple complex features traditional North Indian temple forms and distinctive golden domes.
details.culturalSignificance: It is one of the most important pilgrimage sites for devotees of Lord Shiva.

travelTips.dressCode: Modest traditional attire is recommended; security and entry rules apply.
travelTips.entryFee: Entry and special darshan arrangements vary; check official temple guidance.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is restricted in secure temple areas.

destinations.name: Golden Temple
destinations.summary: A serene Sikh spiritual center surrounded by the sacred Amrit Sarovar and known for its golden sanctum.

details.history: The present complex developed over centuries and became a central place of Sikh worship and community service.
details.architecture: The gilded upper structure combines Sikh architectural traditions with elegant domes, arches, and marble ornamentation.
details.culturalSignificance: The Harmandir Sahib is one of the most important pilgrimage sites in Sikhism and represents equality, service, and devotion.

travelTips.dressCode: Head covering is required and visitors must remove footwear before entering.
travelTips.entryFee: Entry is generally free; special services may have separate arrangements.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is allowed in many outdoor areas, subject to visitor guidelines.

destinations.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
destinations.summary: A magnificent Dravidian temple complex famous for towering gopurams, colorful sculptures, and sacred halls.

details.history: The temple has ancient roots and was extensively expanded under the Nayak rulers.
details.architecture: Classic Dravidian architecture is expressed through monumental gopurams, sculpted pillars, mandapams, and shrines.
details.culturalSignificance: The temple is central to Madurai's religious identity and major cultural festivals.

travelTips.dressCode: Modest traditional clothing is recommended; footwear must be removed.
travelTips.entryFee: Entry and special access fees vary by area and service.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography restrictions apply in several inner areas.

destinations.name: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
destinations.summary: One of India's most visited pilgrimage centers, set among the scenic Tirumala Hills.

details.history: The temple has a long history of royal patronage and centuries of pilgrimage traditions.
details.architecture: The complex follows traditional South Indian temple architecture with a prominent gold-covered sanctum.
details.culturalSignificance: It is one of the most important Vaishnavite pilgrimage destinations in India.

travelTips.dressCode: Traditional or modest attire is required for several temple services.
travelTips.entryFee: Darshan and special-entry fees vary by booking category.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is prohibited in the main temple areas.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.summary: A scenic Himalayan destination surrounded by pine forests, mountain valleys, rivers, and snow-covered peaks.

details.history: Manali developed as a major Himalayan settlement and later became a popular mountain tourism destination.
details.architecture: The region is characterized by traditional Himachali buildings alongside modern mountain resorts.
details.culturalSignificance: Manali represents Himalayan culture and is a gateway to several high-altitude landscapes and adventure experiences.

destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to June and October to February

travelTips.dressCode: Layered clothing and sturdy footwear are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Attraction fees vary by location and season.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed; follow local restrictions in protected areas.

destinations.name: Leh-Ladakh
destinations.summary: A dramatic high-altitude Himalayan region known for stark mountains, blue lakes, monasteries, and desert landscapes.

details.history: Ladakh has been shaped by centuries of Himalayan trade, Buddhist traditions, and mountain communities.
details.architecture: Traditional monasteries and settlements feature Tibetan Buddhist architectural influences.
details.culturalSignificance: Ladakh is renowned for its Buddhist heritage, distinctive landscapes, and resilient high-altitude culture.

travelTips.dressCode: Carry warm layers, sun protection, and allow time for acclimatization.
travelTips.entryFee: Fees vary by attraction and protected-area requirements.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed but may be restricted inside monasteries or sensitive sites.

destinations.name: Munnar
destinations.summary: A lush hill station famous for rolling tea plantations, misty mountains, forests, and cool weather.

details.history: Munnar developed as a major tea-growing region during the colonial period.
details.architecture: Tea estates, colonial-era structures, and traditional Kerala influences shape the region's visual character.
details.culturalSignificance: Munnar is an important part of Kerala's hill tourism and tea-growing heritage.

travelTips.dressCode: Light layers, comfortable shoes, and rain protection are useful.
travelTips.entryFee: Park and attraction fees vary.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally permitted except where restricted by protected-area rules.

destinations.name: Darjeeling
destinations.summary: A charming Himalayan hill town known for tea gardens, colonial heritage, and spectacular mountain views.

details.history: Darjeeling grew as a hill station during the British period and became internationally known for its tea.
details.architecture: Colonial buildings, Himalayan railway infrastructure, and traditional mountain architecture define the town.
details.culturalSignificance: Darjeeling is celebrated for its tea culture, Himalayan heritage, and the UNESCO-recognized mountain railway.

destinations.bestTimeToVisit: March to May and October to December

travelTips.dressCode: Warm layers and comfortable walking shoes are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Attraction and transport fees vary.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally permitted in public areas and viewpoints.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.summary: India's celebrated coastal destination combining sandy beaches, Portuguese heritage, nightlife, and relaxed seaside culture.

details.history: Goa has a long maritime history and was influenced significantly by Portuguese rule.
details.architecture: Portuguese churches, colonial houses, and traditional Goan buildings coexist with modern tourism infrastructure.
details.culturalSignificance: Goa's coastal culture blends local traditions with Portuguese influences, cuisine, music, and festivals.

travelTips.dressCode: Light clothing, sun protection, and beach-appropriate attire are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Most beaches are free; individual attractions and activities have separate charges.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed; respect restrictions at heritage and religious sites.

destinations.name: Radhanagar Beach
destinations.summary: A world-renowned tropical beach known for soft white sand, clear waters, lush forests, and spectacular sunsets.

details.history: The Andaman Islands have a rich maritime and indigenous history shaped by diverse island communities.
details.architecture: The natural landscape rather than built architecture defines the destination, with carefully managed visitor facilities.
details.culturalSignificance: Radhanagar represents the pristine coastal and marine heritage of the Andaman Islands.

travelTips.dressCode: Swimwear and light beach clothing are suitable; carry sun protection.
travelTips.entryFee: Beach access is generally regulated by local tourism authorities.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed; follow local environmental and safety guidelines.

destinations.name: Varkala Beach
destinations.summary: A dramatic Kerala coastline featuring a red laterite cliff, Arabian Sea views, and a relaxed beach atmosphere.

details.history: Varkala has long been associated with pilgrimage, traditional trade, and coastal communities.
details.architecture: The distinctive cliff landscape is complemented by traditional Kerala architecture and a lively cliff-top promenade.
details.culturalSignificance: Varkala combines spiritual traditions with Kerala's coastal tourism culture.

travelTips.dressCode: Light clothing, comfortable footwear, and sun protection are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Beach access is generally free; activities and attractions may have separate charges.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally permitted.

destinations.name: Om Beach
destinations.summary: A scenic beach shaped like the sacred Om symbol, surrounded by rocky hills and Arabian Sea waters.

details.history: Gokarna developed as an important pilgrimage town and coastal settlement.
details.architecture: Traditional temple architecture and simple coastal settlements characterize the region.
details.culturalSignificance: Om Beach is part of Gokarna's unique combination of Hindu pilgrimage and beach tourism.

travelTips.dressCode: Light beachwear and comfortable footwear are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Beach access is generally free; water activities may have separate fees.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed.

destinations.name: Agatti Island
destinations.summary: A tropical island destination surrounded by turquoise lagoons, coral reefs, and pristine beaches.

details.history: Lakshadweep's islands have centuries-old maritime links and distinctive island communities.
details.architecture: Traditional island homes and small-scale coastal infrastructure complement the natural environment.
details.culturalSignificance: Agatti showcases the marine culture, ecology, and island traditions of Lakshadweep.

travelTips.dressCode: Light tropical clothing, reef-safe sun protection, and comfortable sandals are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Entry and island access require applicable permits and travel arrangements.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is generally allowed but follow local environmental and security rules.

destinations.name: Jim Corbett National Park
destinations.summary: India's oldest national park and a celebrated wildlife destination known for forests, rivers, elephants, and Bengal tigers.

details.history: Established in 1936 as Hailey National Park, it was later renamed in honor of conservationist Jim Corbett.
details.architecture: The landscape is primarily natural, featuring sal forests, grasslands, rivers, and foothill ecosystems.
details.culturalSignificance: Corbett is an important center for wildlife conservation and tiger habitat protection in India.

travelTips.dressCode: Neutral outdoor clothing, sturdy shoes, and sun protection are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Safari fees and permits vary by zone and season.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is allowed from designated safari vehicles; do not disturb wildlife.

destinations.name: Ranthambore National Park
destinations.summary: A renowned wildlife reserve where ancient fort ruins meet dry forests and one of India's best-known tiger habitats.

details.history: The park was once a royal hunting reserve before becoming a protected wildlife area.
details.architecture: The landscape combines dry deciduous forests, lakes, rocky terrain, and historic ruins.
details.culturalSignificance: Ranthambore is internationally recognized for tiger conservation and wildlife tourism.

travelTips.dressCode: Neutral outdoor clothing, sturdy footwear, and sun protection are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Safari permits and fees vary by vehicle, zone, and season.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is encouraged from designated vehicles; flash and disturbance of wildlife should be avoided.

destinations.name: Kaziranga National Park
destinations.summary: A UNESCO World Heritage wildlife landscape famous for the Indian one-horned rhinoceros and rich wetland ecosystems.

details.history: The protected area evolved from conservation efforts begun in the early 20th century.
details.architecture: Grasslands, wetlands, forests, and riverine habitats form the park's distinctive natural landscape.
details.culturalSignificance: Kaziranga is a globally important conservation success story for the one-horned rhinoceros.

travelTips.dressCode: Neutral outdoor clothing, comfortable shoes, and rain protection are useful.
travelTips.entryFee: Safari and park entry fees vary by zone and season.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is allowed from designated safari areas; avoid flash and disturbance.

destinations.name: Gir National Park
destinations.summary: A protected forest famous for the Asiatic lion and diverse dry deciduous wildlife.

details.history: The region became a protected habitat through conservation efforts to safeguard the last wild population of Asiatic lions.
details.architecture: The landscape includes dry deciduous forests, grasslands, rocky hills, and seasonal streams.
details.culturalSignificance: Gir is globally significant as the last natural stronghold of the Asiatic lion.

travelTips.dressCode: Neutral outdoor clothing, sturdy footwear, and sun protection are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Safari permits and entry fees vary by zone and season.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is permitted from designated vehicles; maintain distance from wildlife.

destinations.name: Kanha National Park
destinations.summary: A vast central Indian forest celebrated for Bengal tigers, barasingha, sal forests, and scenic grasslands.

details.history: The park was established as a protected area in the 20th century and became an important tiger conservation landscape.
details.architecture: Sal forests, meadows, streams, and bamboo areas create a diverse natural setting.
details.culturalSignificance: Kanha is a major wildlife conservation destination and an important habitat for the hard-ground barasingha.

travelTips.dressCode: Neutral outdoor clothing, sturdy shoes, and sun protection are recommended.
travelTips.entryFee: Safari fees and permits vary by zone and season.
travelTips.photographyRules: Photography is permitted from safari vehicles; flash and wildlife disturbance should be avoided.
